$comment: Phase 131 — the pinned prover. F* releases weekly and this release removed proof hints outright, so an unpinned prover is a gate that changes under you; check.ps1 refuses any other version. The release zip bundles Z3, which is why one pin covers both. Phase 393 — one entry per operating system the leg runs on, every entry the SAME release: the kit resolves the entry by the host's OS, refuses an OS with no entry by name, and refuses an entry whose asset or url names a different release. Each sha256 is the digest GitHub publishes for that release asset.
